Scenario: AC7 An error answer 401, 403 or 404 of the provided operations is returned as the contract states (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a call to a provided operation of section 12.5 that is not authorised, or whose target does not exist
    When the call is answered
    Then the answer is 401, 403 or 404 as the contract states and nothing changes

Scenario: AC8 A retried or timed-out activity writes its outcome once (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given an activity of the field-inspection step is retried or times out
    When the retry or the timeout is resolved
    Then the outcome is written once to the treatment row and the decision record, and no duplicate is written

Scenario: AC9 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a status change that the status model does not allow
    When the change is submitted
    Then the change is refused and nothing changes
